subject: Re: Pricing ask — blending commit tiers with on-demand for premium embeddings and chat
messages:
From: Ava Brown <ava@heliosai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@heliosai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing for high-embed throughput + chat

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking a look. We're evaluating Redwood to power a fresh vector search/assistant surface at HeliosAI. Two quick asks before we sync: 

- We expect ~40B embeddings/month for the first 6 months (mostly 1536-dimension floats), with bursty patterns from nightly batch indexing.
- Chat traffic will be ~120M tokens/month, split roughly 70% short queries (<=128 tokens) and 30% long-form generation (avg 800 tokens).

Questions: 
1) Do you have a blended quote that mixes a committed monthly token/embedding volume with on-demand for spikes?
2) What is your premium model multiplier vs standard model for chat? We may want Redwood's highest-quality chat model for 20% of traffic.
3) Embeddings: are there different bands for float vs quantized embeddings and how do credits work if we exceed commit?

Timing: we'd like a written proposal (including credits or runway incentives) before our procurement call next week. Samir and I can do a 30-min call on Thurs if that helps.

Best,
Ava Brown
Head of Platform Partnerships
HeliosAI
(415) 555-0129

---
Attachment: Helios-volume-projections.xlsx (Excel, 18KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Brown <ava@heliosai.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@heliosai.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing for high-embed throughput + chat

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear numbers. Quick answers and a suggested path: 

1) Blended commit + on-demand: yes — we can structure a commit for the baseline (e.g., 30B embeddings/month + 90M chat tokens/month) with on-demand overage priced separately. For your volumes the economics usually favor a 6–12 month commit with step-down unit rates after defined slabs.

2) Premium models: we apply a model premium multiplier (policy) rather than ad-hoc fees. Typical premium multiplier for our top chat model is 1.7x–1.9x the standard chat unit price depending on commit size. We can offer a 1.6x multiplier at higher commit levels (>=120M tokens/month committed).

3) Embeddings bands: we price "float" embeddings at the standard embedding unit; quantized/low-precision variants can be priced at a ~0.7x factor if quality is acceptable. Overflow beyond commit is billed on-demand at a clearly stated overage rate — we can include a usage credit structure instead of overage to smooth month-to-month variability.

I've attached our latest rate card with slab examples and a short SOW template. If you want, Marissa (cc'd) can draft a blended proposal showing a tradeoff matrix: commit size vs on-demand headroom vs upfront credits. Can you confirm whether you prefer credits (pre-paid usage) or a pure overage model for bursts? Also confirm the 20% premium-model share and whether you want the premium to apply only to the generated tokens (not prompts/embeds).

If helpful, we're available Thurs 10:00–12:00 PT.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
kal: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Karthik — thanks, that helps. A few clarifications so Marissa can model the options accurately: 

- Preference: leaning toward blended commit + usage credits rather than open overage, because procurement is more comfortable with capped spend and runway.
- Premium allocation: we'll likely route the top 20% of users to the premium chat model (higher latency tolerance). That premium should apply to both prompt + generation tokens for those sessions.
- Embeddings: we need high-precision floats for similarity quality; quantized embeddings are not acceptable for our ranking stack right now.
- Contract length: 12 months preferred; renewals may add usage growth.

Two asks: 
1) Can you sketch a small example: commit 30B embeddings + 100M tokens committed, 20% premium share, with 15% usage credits applied as a sign-on incentive? Show blended unit prices and monthly commit fee.
2) Can you confirm whether there is a cap on infra-based surcharges (e.g., for GPU-backed real-time embedding pipelines)?

If you can send a short written example, I'll forward to procurement and we'll set up the Thurs slot if needed.

Best,
Ava

Hi Ava — looping Neha from pricing so you get concrete numbers. Below is a compact worked example based on your ask (12-month term, 15% sign-on usage credits applied to first 3 months).

Worked example (monthly):
- Commit: 30,000,000,000 embeddings/month (float) at $0.0000065/embed = $195,000/month
- Commit: 100,000,000 chat tokens/month at $0.0008/token = $80,000/month
- Premium model uplift: 20% of chat tokens @ 1.7x multiplier = additional $27,200/month (applies to both prompts+completions for those sessions)
- Baseline monthly commit fee = $302,200
- Sign-on usage credits: 15% applied to the first 3 months = equivalent to ~$136,000 credit applied across months 1–3
- On-demand overage rate: embeddings $0.000008/embed; chat tokens 1.15x standard token rate for on-demand spikes

Notes and options: 
- If Helios prefers credits held as prepayment vs automatic overage consumption, we can show both lines in the SOW. Credits give you predictable cashflow; overage is pay-as-you-go.
- Premium multiplier can be reduced to 1.6x if commit increases to >=120M tokens/month or if you increase committed premium share to 30% at baseline.
- There is a capped infra surcharge: we guarantee no infra surcharge above 8% of monthly commit fee for non-custom hardware; custom provisioning (air-gapped or fixed-capacity dedicated pools) may carry a separately negotiated infrastructure uplift.

Next steps: if this aligns, we'll produce a redlined SOW and a 1-page commercial summary for procurement. We can also provide a short Monte Carlo usage-runway view showing how credits smooth month-to-month variability.

Would you like us to draft the procurement-ready commercial summary for your Thurs call?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal Pricing Manager — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | marissa_cole@redwood.ai
